title: Efficiency Request Gateway and Escalation Heuristics for Tuning Consults
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a lightweight intake gateway and scoring heuristic that classifies incoming 'efficiency' and 'tuning' requests (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policy recommendations) and automatically routes them to one of three lanes: self-serve guidance, optimization concierge (timeboxed consult), or enterprise escalation (SLA-backed engagement). The gateway should capture signal for cost/latency sensitivity, data regulatory constraints, and expected throughput to inform prioritization and routing decisions. Deliverables: intake schema, scoring rubric, routing rules, SLA thresholds, and handoff artifacts for engineering/design to implement the UI and automation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form schema defined and stored in Confluence with field-level validation rules
Scoring rubric (0-100) implemented in a single-page decision matrix and reviewed by Eng/SE/PM
Routing rules documented: thresholds for self-serve / concierge / enterprise escalation
Automation spec for webhook & ticket creation in Linear/GH issues for downstream teams
Pilot of 50 incoming requests yields >= 90% correct lane classification vs PM adjudication
Latency target: intake classification completed within 2 hours of request arrival for non-enterprise lanes
